length_limits.notes: No explicit word cap: long enough to convey the work, short enough to read in one sitting. Title up to about 145 characters, summary up to 150 words. Figure and table counts by article type: Articles 7, Reports 4, Brief Reports 2, Methods 7, Methods in Brief 2.

figure_spec.notes: Colour and greyscale at 300 dpi, black and white at 500 dpi, line art at 1,000 dpi, all at final print size. Arial, fonts embedded.

reference_style.style: Numbered in order of first citation, superscript in the text; 'et al.' only after 10 authors.

submission_steps: submit through Editorial Manager at editorialmanager.com/cell-systems
initial submission as a PDF, or Word plus separate files; LaTeX needs an accompanying PDF
keep files to 1-2 MB each and 20 MB in total
a cover letter is required: background, conceptual advance, significance, consortium status, reviewer suggestions
the Cell Press Multi-Journal Submission option is available

template.notes: Word templates and a Cell Press LaTeX zip (.tex, .bib, .bst, .sty) download without a login. Linked, never stored.
